reason: I buy on referrals, and I do not know Donovin or anyone who has used him. Nothing here tells me who in town hired Clockout and whether it worked out.
objection: Even at a fixed price, I am handing over my office manager time and my own Monday mornings to a stranger from Roscoe with no name I can check, and a one-page write-up does not tell me if the fix actually holds up after he is gone.
would_change_my_mind: Two owners of businesses my size, nearby, who will take my call and tell me what he actually fixed and what it cost them.
